f3_program: multiple(at("mark.magic_card.value", "current"), at("mark.magic_card.purchase_price", "purchase"), 3, source("which then triples in value"))
assumptions: The tripled value is interpreted relative to the $100 purchase value.

f3_program: observe(at("daphney.potatoes.purchase.weight", "current"), 5, "kilogram", source("Daphney buys 5 kg of potatoes at the supermarket"))
transfer("purchase", "daphney", "supermarket.potatoes", "daphney.potatoes", at("daphney.potatoes.purchase.weight", "current"), source("Daphney buys 5 kg of potatoes at the supermarket"))
assumptions: The quoted supermarket price rate applies to Daphney's 5 kg purchase.
The requested ratio is represented by the allowlisted percentage_ratio query.

f3_program: partition("yarn.parts", at("yarn.length", "initial"), source("A 10 meters yarn was cut into 5 equal parts"))
observe(at("yarn.parts.used_for_crocheting.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("3 parts were used for crocheting"))
consume("crocheting_use", "crocheting", at("yarn.length", "current"), "yarn.used_for_crocheting.length", source("3 parts were used for crocheting"))
assumptions: Crocheting is treated as the consuming process in the passive construction.
